snippet.title: Polylithic | 1.0 Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
It is the Stone Age. Humans are not yet apex predators. You are, however, now out of excuses.

Polylithic 1.0 is out now on PC via Steam. Lead your tribe from desperate Paleolithic hunter-gatherers to the first permanent settlements of the Neolithic age.  

Craft, hunt, cook with chaotic results, and try not to get eaten by something that has been doing this far longer than you have.

🌍 Vibrant low-poly open world
🪨 Deep tech tree from Paleolithic to Neolithic
🐕 Tame a dog. Or a hyena. Both loyal. One alarming.
⚔️ Enemy tribes with their own ideas about prehistory
🍖 Cooking system that generates recipes with chaotic results
👥 Online co-op for up to 10 players

Play now ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839060/Polylithic/
Find all the ways to play ➤ https://store.indie.io/polylithic

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
